{"target_smiles":"CCN(CC(O)(CNc1cc(C)cc2c1cnn2-c1ccccc1)C(F)(F)F)C(=O)c1ccccc1","routes":[{"strategy_plan":"本路线针对目标分子中含三氟甲基叔醇侧链与2-苯基吲唑核心的结构特征，采取高度汇聚的合成策略。首先在后期通过6-甲基-2-苯基-2H-吲唑-7-胺对含三氟甲基与N-乙基苯甲酰胺基的环氧化合物进行区域选择性开环，构建关键的C-N键与三氟甲基叔醇骨架。环氧化合物片段由苯甲酰氯与乙胺缩合、经2-(三氟甲基)烯丙基溴烷基化并进一步环氧化得到。吲唑胺片段则以6-甲基-2-硝基苯甲醛与苯胺缩合形成亚胺，随后经Cadogan还原环化构建2-苯基吲唑母核，再依次进行C7位硝化与硝基还原获得芳胺。该路线原料廉价易得，各步反应选择性好且反应条件温和可靠。","key_disconnection_class":"Epoxide opening","disconnection_type":"coupling","planned_num_steps":8,"strategy":"环氧开环与Cadogan吲唑合成汇聚策略","route_id":1,"steps":[{"step_id":1,"product":"CCN(CC(O)(CNc1cc(C)cc2c1cnn2-c1ccccc1)C(F)(F)F)C(=O)c1ccccc1","precursors":["Cc1cc(N)c2cnn(-c3ccccc3)c2c1","CCN(CC1(C(F)(F)F)CO1)C(=O)c1ccccc1"],"reaction_class":"Epoxide opening"},{"step_id":2,"product":"CCN(CC1(C(F)(F)F)CO1)C(=O)c1ccccc1","precursors":["C=C(CN(CC)C(=O)c1ccccc1)C(F)(F)F","O=C(OO)c1cccc(Cl)c1"],"reaction_class":"Prilezhaev epoxidation"},{"step_id":3,"product":"C=C(CN(CC)C(=O)c1ccccc1)C(F)(F)F","precursors":["CCNC(=O)c1ccccc1","C=C(CBr)C(F)(F)F"],"reaction_class":"Alkylation"},{"step_id":4,"product":"CCNC(=O)c1ccccc1","precursors":["O=C(Cl)c1ccccc1","CCN"],"reaction_class":"Schotten-Baumann amidation"},{"step_id":5,"product":"Cc1cc(N)c2cnn(-c3ccccc3)c2c1","precursors":["Cc1cc([N+](=O)[O-])c2cnn(-c3ccccc3)c2c1"],"reaction_class":"Nitro reduction"},{"step_id":6,"product":"Cc1cc([N+](=O)[O-])c2cnn(-c3ccccc3)c2c1","precursors":["Cc1ccc2c(cnn2-c2ccccc2)c1","O=[N+]([O-])O"],"reaction_class":"Electrophilic aromatic substitution"},{"step_id":7,"product":"Cc1ccc2c(cnn2-c2ccccc2)c1","precursors":["Cc1c(C=Nc2ccccc2)cccc1[N+](=O)[O-]","CCOP(OCC)OCC"],"reaction_class":"Cadogan cyclization"},{"step_id":8,"product":"Cc1c(C=Nc2ccccc2)cccc1[N+](=O)[O-]","precursors":["Cc1c(C=O)cccc1[N+](=O)[O-]","Nc1ccccc1"],"reaction_class":"Imine formation"}],"starting_materials":["C=C(CBr)C(F)(F)F","CCN","CCOP(OCC)OCC","Cc1c(C=O)cccc1[N+](=O)[O-]","Nc1ccccc1","O=C(Cl)c1ccccc1","O=C(OO)c1cccc(Cl)c1","O=[N+]([O-])O"]}]}
